science.qualification: Photosphere color from the star's ground-based spectrophotometry (Pulkovo catalogue). The disc is unresolved: it is darkened toward the limb by the quadratic V-band law Claret & Bloemen (2011) compute from ATLAS model atmospheres at the star's temperature and gravity, a model rather than a measurement; no map or absolute brightness is implied. Self-luminous, so no lighting. The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the power law I(mu) = mu^0.258 that Lacour et al. (2008), A&A 485, 561 fit to the star's resolved disc (IOTA/IONIC H band, 1.5-1.8 um, seven channels fitted with one law; not a visible band).

offLimbContext.source: none: no observation, a transparent plate

limbMaterial.composition: black alpha darkens the photosphere according to the selected limb-darkening law; transparent outside the silhouette
